survey: A single inflatable beach ball rests on rippled sand, with orange dunes behind it. The camera is slightly above the ball and a little to its left. The ball's axis is tilted toward the viewer, so its purple valve cap sits on the upper front of the sphere instead of at the very top. The cap is a short cylinder seen as a horizontal ellipse, about 0.8 times as tall as it is wide. Its lower side wall shows, which matches a surface that faces mostly toward the camera and slightly up. Six panels (red, white, blue, white, green, white) all meet at the cap. They widen as they curve down and around the sphere, and the green panel shows only at the back right, as it should. The bottom of the ball sinks slightly into the sand. Its contact shadow falls to the lower right on sand seen from the same slightly raised angle. The rows of sand ripples get smaller and closer together toward the dunes, which matches the ground plane under the ball. Everything agrees on one viewpoint.
